name: +1 Speed Plane Escape
desc:
👑 Welcome to +1 Speed Plane Escape! ✈️

⚡ Every step = +1 Speed
🚀 Increase your speed to fly farther and farther
💪 Train your speed and unlock powerful multipliers
🏁 Race against friends and other players
🔥 Rebirth to push your limits
🏆 Become the FASTEST PLANE on the server
🪐 Watch your flight… one mistake sends you back 😱

👍 If you're having fun, don't forget to like the game!

scripts.title: THE GAME QUALITY INITIATIVE
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Fallback Coordinates (+2 studs Y)
local FALLBACK_CFRAME = CFrame.new(293.2171936035156, 135.6019287109375, -9081.99609375)

-- Path lookup with fallback
local function getTargetCFrame()
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	local stages = map and map:FindFirstChild("Stages")
	local stage15 = stages and stages:FindFirstChild("Stage15")
	local endPlatform = stage15 and stage15:FindFirstChild("end_platform")
	local buttons = endPlatform and endPlatform:FindFirstChild("Buttons")
	local targetPart = buttons and buttons:FindFirstChild("x1win")
	
	if targetPart then
		if targetPart:IsA("BasePart") then
			return targetPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), "Path (x1win)"
		else
			return targetPart:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), "Path (x1win)"
		end
	end
	
	return FALLBACK_CFRAME, "Fallback Coordinates"
end

-- Clean up any preexisting instances
for _, existingGui in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
	if existingGui.Name == "GameQualityInitiativeGui" then
		existingGui:Destroy()
	end
end

-- Create ScreenGui
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "GameQualityInitiativeGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

-- Main Container Frame
local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 270)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -170, 0.25, 0)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 26, 32)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Draggable = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
uiCorner.Parent = mainFrame

local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
uiStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
uiStroke.Thickness = 2
uiStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
uiStroke.Parent = mainFrame

-- Title Bar
local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
titleLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 35, 45)
titleLabel.Text = "⚡ THE GAME QUALITY INITIATIVE"
titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
titleLabel.TextSize = 13
titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
titleLabel.Parent = mainFrame

local titleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
titleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
titleCorner.Parent = titleLabel

-- Close / Cleanup Button ("X")
local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)
closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -35, 0, 5)
closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
closeBtn.Text = "✕"
closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
closeBtn.TextSize = 14
closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
closeBtn.Parent = mainFrame

local closeBtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
closeBtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
closeBtnCorner.Parent = closeBtn

-- Scrolling Frame Menu
local scrollFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
scrollFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -55)
scrollFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 48)
scrollFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
scrollFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
scrollFrame.ScrollBarThickness = 6
scrollFrame.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
scrollFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 280)
scrollFrame.Parent = mainFrame

local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
listLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
listLayout.Parent = scrollFrame

-- Status Display
local statusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
statusLabel.LayoutOrder = 1
statusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25)
statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
statusLabel.Text = "Status: Ready"
statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
statusLabel.TextSize = 13
statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
statusLabel.Parent = scrollFrame

-- Leaderboard Wins Tracker Display
local winsLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
winsLabel.LayoutOrder = 2
winsLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25)
winsLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
winsLabel.Text = "Wins Value: Searching..."
winsLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0)
winsLabel.TextSize = 13
winsLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
winsLabel.Parent = scrollFrame

-- Divider 1
local divider1 = Instance.new("Frame")
divider1.LayoutOrder = 3
divider1.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
divider1.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 50, 65)
divider1.BorderSizePixel = 0
divider1.Parent = scrollFrame

-- Teleport Only Button
local tpBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
tpBtn.LayoutOrder = 4
tpBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
tpBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
tpBtn.Text = "TELEPORT ONCE"
tpBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
tpBtn.TextSize = 13
tpBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
tpBtn.Parent = scrollFrame

local tpBtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
tpBtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
tpBtnCorner.Parent = tpBtn

-- Divider 2
local divider2 = Instance.new("Frame")
divider2.LayoutOrder = 5
divider2.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
divider2.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 50, 65)
divider2.BorderSizePixel = 0
divider2.Parent = scrollFrame

-- Auto Farm Toggle Container
local autoFarmFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
autoFarmFrame.LayoutOrder = 6
autoFarmFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
autoFarmFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 35, 45)
autoFarmFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
autoFarmFrame.Parent = scrollFrame

local autoFarmCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
autoFarmCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
autoFarmCorner.Parent = autoFarmFrame

local autoFarmLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
autoFarmLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.65, 0, 1, 0)
autoFarmLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, 0)
autoFarmLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
autoFarmLabel.Text = "Auto Farm"
autoFarmLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
autoFarmLabel.TextSize = 12
autoFarmLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
autoFarmLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
autoFarmLabel.Parent = autoFarmFrame

local autoFarmBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
autoFarmBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 0.7, 0)
autoFarmBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0.15, 0)
autoFarmBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
autoFarmBtn.Text = "OFF"
autoFarmBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
autoFarmBtn.TextSize = 12
autoFarmBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
autoFarmBtn.Parent = autoFarmFrame

local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
toggleCorner.Parent = autoFarmBtn

-- Cleanup Handler Function
local function removeAllGuis()
	for _, child in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
		if child.Name == "GameQualityInitiativeGui" then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(removeAllGuis)

-- Leaderboard Wins Tracker Logic
local function trackWins()
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") or player:WaitForChild("leaderstats", 5)
	if leaderstats then
		local wins = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Wins") or leaderstats:WaitForChild("Wins", 5)
		if wins then
			winsLabel.Text = "Wins Value: " .. tostring(wins.Value)
			winsLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 150)
			wins.Changed:Connect(function(newValue)
				winsLabel.Text = "Wins Value: " .. tostring(newValue)
			end)
			return
		end
	end
	winsLabel.Text = "Wins Value: Not Found"
	winsLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
end

task.spawn(trackWins)

-- Single Teleport Function
local function runTeleportOnly()
	local targetCFrame, targetSource = getTargetCFrame()
	local character = player.Character
	if character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = targetCFrame
		statusLabel.Text = "Status: Teleported (" .. targetSource .. ")"
		statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 150)
	end
end

tpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(runTeleportOnly)

-- Auto Farm Loop (Repeated Teleport)
local autoFarmEnabled = false

local function startAutoFarm()
	task.spawn(function()
		while autoFarmEnabled do
			runTeleportOnly()
			task.wait(1)
		end
	end)
end

autoFarmBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	autoFarmEnabled = not autoFarmEnabled
	if autoFarmEnabled then
		autoFarmBtn.Text = "ON"
		autoFarmBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 100)
		startAutoFarm()
	else
		autoFarmBtn.Text = "OFF"
		autoFarmBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
	end
end)
